name: CyberSecEval
description: CyberSecEval is a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate the cybersecurity safety of large language models used as coding assistants. It assesses models on their tendency to generate insecure code and their compliance when asked to assist in cyberattacks, providing insights to improve model security.
general_score_metric: attack success rate / insecure code rate
reputation: A recent cybersecurity benchmark that has quickly become a useful reference for assessing insecure code generation and cyber misuse behavior in coding assistants.
notes: Covers both insecure code generation and compliance with cyberattack assistance; includes automated test case generation and evaluation pipeline.
